## LeadTime Guard: daily risk email
Every morning n8n downloads the latest risk register (the output of the Python agent), keeps only RED and AMBER items and emails one summary to the project team.

**Setup:** open *Send email (Gmail)*, connect your Google account and put your own address in *To*.

This workflow only **notifies** the team. Supplier emails are drafts that a person approves in the dashboard. Nothing is sent to suppliers.
